issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a subroutine named set_pixel with the calling convention described (x in EAX, y in EBX, color in ECX). The template declares a set_pixel label (TODO) for students to implement. The provided solution, however, implements a subroutine named write_pixel and does not define set_pixel, while main still calls set_pixel. This name/signature mismatch means the solution is structurally incompatible with the template/problem: building or following the solution will lead to an undefined symbol (set_pixel) and confuses students about the required subroutine name/signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution define set_pixel with the exact name and calling convention described in the problem/template. Either rename the existing write_pixel to set_pixel, or add a small set_pixel wrapper that forwards parameters to write_pixel while preserving the required register-preservation contract (inputs: EAX = x, EBX = y, ECX = color; preserve all registers except EAX as specified). Ensure main's call to set_pixel links to a valid label.
